speaker: Bloomberg

clips.speaker: Bloomberg
clips.title: 高盛Kaplan：美联储需关注历史性资本支出热潮

subtitles.en: Clearly, we've seen tariffs and immigration policy, whether or not you agree with it,
subtitles.zh: 显然，无论你是否同意，关税和移民政策已经推高了通胀。

subtitles.en: drive inflation higher, and then this war in Iran boosting us another leg to a point where CPI was at 4.2.
subtitles.zh: 随后伊朗战争进一步推高物价，CPI达到4.2%。

subtitles.en: So more than twice the Fed's target.
subtitles.zh: 是美联储目标的两倍多。

subtitles.en: But now it seems like the war is over, and the straight-of-war moose is going to open up again.
subtitles.zh: 但现在战争似乎结束了，霍尔木兹海峡将重新开放。
zh_highlights: 霍尔木兹海峡将重新开放

subtitles.en: Oil has dropped. That price has come down considerably. Now we're at $4 or a national average.
subtitles.zh: 油价大幅下跌，全国平均价格降至4美元。
zh_highlights: 全国平均价格降至4美元

subtitles.en: Is inflation no longer a concern for this country?
subtitles.zh: 通胀不再是这个国家的担忧了吗？

subtitles.en: It's not that straightforward, but the straight-being open and oil prices being down will absolutely help, because I think there was a bleed from high oil prices into other items,
subtitles.zh: 没那么简单，但海峡开放和油价下跌绝对有帮助，因为高油价的影响会传导至其他商品。
en_highlights: straight-being open and oil prices being down
bleed from high oil prices into other items

subtitles.en: and I think that bleed will stop. Here's this structural issue.
subtitles.zh: 我认为这种传导会停止。但这里存在结构性问题。

subtitles.en: We are in the midst of a historic capex boom in the United States driven by infrastructure
subtitles.zh: 我们正处于美国历史性的资本支出热潮中，由AI数据中心、电力和计算基础设施驱动。
zh_highlights: 历史性的资本支出热潮

subtitles.en: for AI data centers, power, creating compute.
subtitles.zh: 为AI数据中心、电力和计算基础设施提供支持。

subtitles.en: And at the same time, as you mentioned, we've got this infrastructure boom that creates demand for materials and labor.
subtitles.zh: 同时，正如你提到的，基础设施繁荣带来了对材料和劳动力的需求。

subtitles.en: We've got constraints because of tariffs, to some extent, and we have constraints because of sluggish, very little labor force growth.
subtitles.zh: 由于关税和劳动力增长缓慢，我们面临一些限制。

subtitles.en: And so that is naturally creates some inflationary dynamic.
subtitles.zh: 这自然会产生一些通胀压力。
